page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a centred title block over the full width: "DE EPISCOPATU ... DISPUTATIO." Below it, one text column with a large woodcut initial at the left, and under the text a gathering signature "A" at the centre foot. Page number at top right. No margin notes, no running head.

main_text.head: DE EPISCOPATU Constantini Magni, SEU De Potestate Magistratus in rebus Ecclesiasticis, DISPUTATIO.
main_text.p: Egimus Disputatione præcedente de Naturâ Ecclesiæ & Concilиis, & anatomen proposuimus librorum quatuor Bellarmini. Sequitur ut agamus de membris Ecclesiæ militantis, inter quæ præcipuum membrum est Magistratus, quamvis eum Bellarminus adeò deprimat, ut in Ecclesiâ infimum locum ei post quosvis Clericos adscribat contra verbum Dei, cujus nos ordinem sequemur, ut etiam quæstione præcedente à nobis factum est.

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to the first word as "Egimus". The title is set in mixed roman, italic and spaced capitals; long s has been normalised to s. The spellings "Concilиis" in the second line of the body is printed as "Conciliis" and should be checked: the letter shape is doubtful, so [?] applies to "Concilиis" if read literally. Printed ligatures and dashes at line ends (for example "anatomen", "quatuor", "membrum") are not reproduced. Scan marks, dots and the "Digitized by Google" credit are excluded.
